name: Tower elevation (players)
asset_source: Build it from player/handouts/tower-elevation.typ in the session materials, or draw the four faces with one window per floor and chains between them.
notes: The honest map. Four faces of the tower, every window in its true position, chains drawn between them, no room numbers anywhere. Safe to show the players; the exterior never lies about height or facing.

name: The Spire (GM only)
notes: Prescott's exploded isometric. Keep it to yourself until the game is over; the interior geometry is the puzzle and the map gives away the gates. Afterwards it is a fine reveal.

name: Rooftop altar
notes: Room 24. Wind, iron rods, a drift of grit, a low altar, and the chain the party climbed.

name: Hall of the Giants
notes: Blank tactical grid for rooms 16 and 17, built for people twice your height. Firepit, iron pot, heaps of hay, six sacks of silver.

name: Dire Pelicans' Roost
notes: Blank tactical grid for room 9. Four windows, one per face, all opening onto the second floor. Seven birds.
